explanation: explorerSession.ts now owns both sides of the analysis snapshot: snapshot(context) writes the gene selection, volcano and pathway settings into the version-1 ExplorerAnalysisState, or returns undefined at defaults, beside the existing restoreAnalysis. It compares against the session's own defaults (VOLCANO_DEFAULT, PATHWAY_SEARCH_DEFAULT, PATHWAY_FDR_DEFAULT, PATHWAY_SORT_DEFAULT, DB_DEFAULT_FILTER), and the volcano and pathway slices open at those same constants. The caller supplies the contrast, the dataset default contrast and the chart scale through AnalysisContext.
